title: 第三章 甘泉劫太极显威第四章 天外来客与明珠之约
lines: 天圆地方，日暮途远。台焕一行离了下水镇，又行两日，终抵甘泉镇地界。
此地本该清泉甘冽，绿树成荫，如今却见土地焦裂，热气蒸腾。镇口那口百年古井，竟咕嘟咕嘟冒着赤红浆泡——清水已化为岩浆，灼热逼人。
“好烫！”台灵伸手试探，急急缩回。鹰捷擦了把汗，眯眼望向镇中：“俄磊曾说过，甘泉镇通鹰城水脉。若此地水脉断绝，鹰城必成死域。”话音未落，街角转出一个身披重甲、步履蹒跚的魁梧身影。
那人面色蜡黄，眼圈发黑，似常年醉酒未醒，手中提着一柄沉重的流星锤，沙哑笑道：“台城的小崽子，果然来了。吾乃失足将军，奉罗正大人之命，守此甘泉！”
“失足将军？”台焕将台灵护在身后，道晶兽伏于肩头，金鳞微颤。台焕身形本就清瘦，九岁孩童，四肢细长，仿佛一阵风就能吹倒。
然而那瘦削的身躯里，却蕴藏着惊人的力量。
“正是。”失足将军打了个酒嗝，锤指台焕，
“听说你有神兵兽？嘿嘿，本将军今日……哎哟！”他话未说完，台焕已如离弦之箭冲出！
瘦小的身躯足尖一点，身形如鹤，臂膀竟爆发出惊人力道，一拳直取中路！
“临！”拳风凛冽，吐字如雷。道家九字真言第一字出口，台焕周身似有一层无形罡气护体，拳势更添三分锐利。
“兵！”侧身避锤，肘击软肋。
“斗！”矮身扫腿，足尖点地，焦土崩裂。失足将军大惊，他未料到这瘦猴般的少年竟有如此武力，且不倚仗神兵兽，全凭肉身拳意！
那九字真言字字铿锵，每一字吐出，台焕的动作便更精妙一分，力道更沉雄一分。
“者！皆！阵！列！在！前！”九字念完，台焕身形已如鬼魅，瘦小的身躯在失足将军周身游走，每一掌拍出，都似重锤击鼓。
失足将军甲胄凹陷，连连后退，最后一句
“前”字出口，台焕双掌齐出，印在其胸！
“砰！”失足将军如断线风筝，倒飞入街边茅屋，砸塌半堵土墙。
“好……好强的力道……”失足将军咳出一口血，爬起来便逃，
“小子，有本事别走！”台灵欢呼：“哥好厉害！”台焕收势，瘦削的胸膛微微起伏。
他自幼修习台城秘传炼体术，虽身形似竹，骨力却如钢，九字真言更是能激发生理极限，以瘦小之躯爆发龙象之力。
然而不过半柱香，大地突然震颤！
“轰隆隆——”远处山崖传来轰鸣，赤红岩浆如瀑布倾泻而下，瞬间将入镇的道路封死。
失足将军去而复返，身后跟着一头庞然大物——那兽形似巨蜥，通体赤红，背生晶刺，周身缠绕着高温蒸汽，所过之处，岩浆退避，清水沸腾！
“熔渊兽！”失足将军狂笑，
“将军我差点忘了，此地有岩浆河！熔渊兽，元素转化！”熔渊兽张口一喷，并非火焰，而是一道赤红光束，瞬间缠绕在道晶兽身上。
道晶兽金鳞一滞，竟如被无形熔岩浇铸，僵在原地，额前
“道”字暗淡无光——元素转化之力，将水元素神兵兽封入岩浆牢笼。
“道晶兽！”台焕急呼。那定身之力源于纯粹的能量转化，熔渊兽将水化作实质岩浆牢笼，元素转化，虚实倒悬，虽非冰雪，却同样封死了一切生机。
“哈哈哈！神兵兽被封，看你这瘦皮猴还能如何！”失足将军流星锤砸来。
台焕抱起僵直的道晶兽急退，鹰捷抓起台灵，三人且战且退，直退至镇后山崖之下。
此处有一眼隐蔽山泉，本是甘泉镇水源源头，如今也被岩浆污染，咕嘟作响。
“怎么办？”鹰捷放下台灵，急道，
“道晶兽不动，我们打不过那怪物！”台焕将冰封般的道晶兽放在青石上，瘦削的肩膀绷得笔直。

The sky is round, the sun sets and the distance is far. Tai Huan and his party left Xiashui Town and traveled for two more days before finally arriving at the boundary of Ganquan Town.
This place is supposed to have clear springs, sweet springs, and green trees, but now the land is scorched and steaming. The century-old well at the entrance of the town was bubbling with red slurry - the clear water had turned into lava, and it was scorching hot.
"It's so hot!" Tai Ling stretched out his hand to test and quickly retracted it. Ying Jie wiped his sweat and looked at the town with squinted eyes: "O Lei once said that Ganquan Town is connected to the water veins of Eagle City. If the water veins here are cut off, Eagle City will become a dead zone." Before he finished speaking, a burly figure wearing heavy armor and shambling walked out from the corner of the street.
The man's complexion was sallow and his eyes were dark, as if he had been drunk for many years. He held a heavy bolas in his hand and said with a hoarse smile: "The little brat from Taicheng is indeed here. I am General Luo Zheng, and I have been ordered by Master Luo Zheng to guard this sweet spring!"
"General who lost his footing?" Tai Huan protected Tai Ling behind him, with the Dao Crystal Beast lying on his shoulders, his golden scales trembling slightly. Tai Huan has a slim figure, like that of a nine-year-old child, with slender limbs, as if he could be blown over by a gust of wind.
However, that thin body contains amazing power.
"Exactly." The fallen general burped and pointed at Tai Huan.
"I heard that you have a magical beast? Hey, General, today... Ouch!" Before he could finish his words, Tai Huan rushed out like an arrow from a string!
His thin body was on tiptoe, and his figure was like a crane. His arms exploded with astonishing strength, and he punched straight in the middle!
"Come!" The fist was fierce and the words were spoken like thunder. When the first word of the nine-character Taoist mantra came out, Tai Huan seemed to be protected by a layer of invisible Gangqi, and his fists were even more sharp.
"Soldier!" He turned sideways to avoid the hammer and hit his weak spot with his elbow.
"Fight!" He lowered his body and swept his legs, his toes touched the ground, and the scorched earth cracked. The general who lost his footing was shocked. He did not expect that this skinny monkey-like young man could have such a powerful force, and he did not rely on magical weapons and beasts, but relied solely on his physical body and fists!
Each word of the nine-character mantra was sonorous, and with each word spoken, Tai Huan's movements became more subtle and powerful.
"All! All! Array! In front!" After reading the nine words, Tai Huan's figure was like a ghost. His thin body was wandering around the general who lost his footing. Every palm shot was like a heavy hammer beating a drum.
The general lost his footing, his armor was dented, and he retreated repeatedly. The last sentence
When the word "front" came out, Tai Huan came out with both palms and printed it on his chest!
"Bang!" The general who lost his footing was like a kite with its string cut off, flying upside down into the thatched house on the street, smashing half of the earth wall.
"So... so strong..." The general who lost his footing coughed up a mouthful of blood, got up and ran away.
"Boy, don't leave if you have the ability!" Tai Ling cheered: "Brother is so awesome!" Tai Huan stopped, his thin chest rising and falling slightly.
He has practiced Taicheng's secret body refining techniques since he was a child. Although his body is shaped like bamboo, his bones are as strong as steel. The nine-character mantra can even push his physical limits to the limit, and he can explode with the power of a dragon or elephant with his thin body.
However, with only half a stick of incense, the earth suddenly trembled!
"Rumble--" There was a roar from the cliff in the distance, and red magma poured down like a waterfall, instantly blocking the road into the town.
The general who lost his footing came back, followed by a huge beast - the beast looked like a giant lizard, its body was red, with crystal spines on its back, and its body was wrapped in high-temperature steam. Wherever it passed, the magma retreated and the water boiled!
"Abyss Beast!" The general who lost his footing laughed wildly,
"General, I almost forgot, there is a river of magma here! Molten Abyss Beast, elemental transformation!" The Molten Abyss Beast opened its mouth and spat out, not flames, but a red beam of light, which instantly wrapped around the Dao Crystal Beast.
The Dao Crystal Beast's golden scales stagnated, as if cast by invisible lava. It froze in place, its forehead
The word "Tao" is dim and dull - the power of elemental transformation seals the water elemental divine weapon beast into a magma cage.
"Dao Crystal Beast!" Tai Huan shouted urgently. The power of holding one's body comes from pure energy transformation. The molten abyss beast turns water into a substantial magma cage. The elements are transformed, and the reality and reality are suspended upside down. Although it is not ice and snow, it also seals away all life.
"Hahaha! The Divine Weapon Beast has been sealed, let's see what you, skinny monkey, can do!" He stumbled and hit the general with his meteor hammer.
Tai Huan picked up the stiff Dao Jing Beast and retreated quickly, while Ying Jie grabbed Tai Ling. The three of them fought and retreated until they retreated to the cliff behind the town.
There is a hidden mountain spring here, which was originally the source of water for Ganquan Town. Now it is also polluted by magma and makes a gurgling sound.
"What should I do?" Ying Jie put down the Tai Ling and asked anxiously,
"The Dao Crystal Beast doesn't move, we can't defeat that monster!" Tai Huan placed the frozen Dao Crystal Beast on the bluestone, his thin shoulders straightened.
